name: The Miki Komori Project
source:
Before the streams…
Before the audience…
Before anyone knew her name…

there was Miki.

Enter a surreal visual novel exploring the hidden lore behind TheMikiKomori, the mysterious angel shark VTuber drifting between loneliness, memory, and the endless pull of the digital sea.

This is the story before the streams, before the audience, and before the name “TheMikiKomori” ever existed. Follow Miki as she navigates loneliness, identity, and the strange events that slowly guide her toward an uncertain future.

Uncover hidden secrets, forge emotional connections, and piece together the origins of a girl who was never meant to be found.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4703120]Steam[/url]]
